about_the_game:
A point-and-click parody of Les Misérables.

Play as Claude Van Claude: imprisoned for 14 years for stealing a loaf of bread, just released and on a desperate quest to find his daughter before she's caught in a violent revolution gripping the streets of Paris. Meanwhile, Inspector LaBleugh is in chase, threatening to send Claude back to jail unless he can finally pull off a daring escape…

Helped by lively period characters, including eccentric blacksmiths, paranoid bakers, Alexandre Dumas and Hector Berlioz, you'll help revolutionaries with suspiciously long baguettes, break into Notre Dame, and ride a horseless horse.

๏ Hand drawn art for your eyes!

๏ Live voice performance for your ears!

๏ Mysteries and puzzles for your brain!

๏ Star-crossed lovers for your heart!

๏ Parisian sewers for your nose!

short_description: A point-and-click parody of Les Miserables. Part 'Monkey Island', part 'Allo 'Allo, Less Miserables aims to do for 'Les Misérables' what 'Life of Brian' did to The Bible. Vive la révolution!
